scope: One exact Bob/Angel/Space Age F210 standalone2.1.23 data/settings and ordinary responsive-menu workload on Black Glass. No save/gameplay/client/runtime/Portal or release qualification follows.

semantic_prerequisites.retained_intent_adverse: The original strict comparison detected four declared legacy-credit rows missing from the older independent intent. PR1308 independently authored those exact rows from published upstream/source-save obligations; all prior160 dispositions remain unchanged. R02 then equals the complete intended data/settings output.

restoration.note: The subsequent guarded assignment independently required original C563 keeper and A15 observer before staging. Current library is separately owned by that new assignment; no concurrent mutation/readback of its selected archives is performed here.

analysis.method_recorded: after execution; uses existing eight-block Student-t arithmetic and the unchanged pre-execution sample/tolerance plan; no samples discarded or extensions
analysis.assumption: Eight paired blocks treated as independent and roughly symmetric. Small-sample intervals do not prove equivalence, universality or an acceptance pass.
analysis.memory_acceptance: not determined by this endpoint analysis
